retrieval.limitations: NBER registers working-paper DOIs (10.3386/wNNNNN) at Crossref; chapters, books and the retired t/h series are excluded by the DOI pattern. Crossref deposits may omit or delay individual papers.

Read from the RePEc central ReDIF mirror because CEPR's own archive (repec.cepr.org) returns HTTP 403; RePEc notes the mirror may lag the publisher archive. Only .rdf files are read; PDFs in the same directory are never downloaded.
retrieval.coverage_note: The RePEc mirror ends at DP21601 while CEPR has issued up to DP22115 (checked 2026-11-08), so the newest few months are missing; 80 recent papers collected earlier are kept.

retrieval.limitations: Official IZA publisher ReDIF archive (per-year files from 1998). Author e-mails and workplaces in the files are discarded. Files are Windows-1252 encoded.

IFS re-deposited old working papers in 2025-2026, so years come from the DOI convention (providers.doi_convention_year). Briefing notes, CeMMAP and other IFS series are excluded by the DOI pattern. The IFS RePEc archive (ifs.org.uk) returns HTTP 403 to automated clients.
retrieval.coverage_note: Two records keep Crossref's re-deposit year because their DOI encodings disagree (wp.ifs.2000.9710, briefing note wp.ifs.2017.0194).
